html:
Tanzania is a country in East Africa on the Indian Ocean, home to Mount Kilimanjaro. It was formed in 1964 when mainland Tanganyika joined the islands of Zanzibar.

The coast belonged to the Swahili city-states, and the 1800s Sultanate of Zanzibar ran caravans deep inland for ivory and slaves. Germany took the mainland as German East Africa from 1885.

  • 1905 to 1907: the Maji Maji rebellion against forced cotton growing, crushed with a famine that killed very many.
  • After World War I: Britain ruled the mainland as Tanganyika, where the groundnut scheme failed badly after 1946.
  • 1961: Tanganyika independent under Julius Nyerere.
  • 1964: the Zanzibar Revolution overthrew the sultan; three months later the two joined as Tanzania.
  • 1967: the Arusha Declaration set out Ujamaa, a village socialism.
  • 1978 to 1979: Tanzania beat Idi Amin's invasion and drove him from Uganda.

Nyerere stepped down in 1985. Swahili, which he promoted, helped make Tanzania one of Africa's most stable countries.
sum: Tanzania is a country in East Africa on the Indian Ocean, home to Mount Kilimanjaro. It was formed in 1964 when mainland Tanganyika joined the islands of Zanzibar.
